allocations.rationale: Investigating Jouret et al. (2022) alongside Olley and Alesi directly unlocks a 14+ patient cohort with granular age-stratified and variant-stratified phenotypic data.
Resolves the citation error (PMID 29379197 vs 30054598) and confirms exact per-cohort numerator/denominator clinical frequencies for foundational BRD4 cases.
